Ever imagine what it would be like if the Pokémon Company did a Legends game set in the wild west? Well you don't have to imagine anymore! **PokéFrontiers** is a new **Cobblemon server** built around that idea, focusing on the **spirit of exploration and discovery**. Set in wild, untamed regions known as Frontiers, players will take on the role of **Frontier Scouts** (_trainers sent to chart, tame, and catalogue the vast unknown regions_). **Explore, Forage, Craft and Levelup** in **Monsai** one of **PokéFrontier's** first frontiers.

Building on that spirit of discovery, the gameplay experience is driven by a deep **forage-based economy** and **custom crafting system**, where the resources you gather in the wild are essential for your survival and progression. When you aren't out in the brush, the **main settlement** serves as a bustling hub of activity; here, you can test your strategy in the **PokéCard Flip minigame** or trade for potential powerhouses at the **Egg Exchange**. As you follow the main story, you will eventually face the frontier's greatest challenges: **Domains**. These **Pokémon-controlled dungeons** feature repeatable boss battles that demand your best tactics and offer legendary rewards for those brave enough to enter.

Your journey as a Scout is further enriched by a **captivating main story** focused on monsai's regional gimmick **Astral Alignment**. Between major milestones, you can visit the **Task Board** to take on specialized missions that reward your dedication to the Frontier. As you rise through the ranks and master the wild, you can define your unique identity with a variety of **player cosmetics**, ensuring your Scout looks the part. Whether you are following the narrative to its end or simply carving out your own path, PokéFrontiers ensures that every action contributes to your growing legacy in the untamed world.

Server Ip: **play.pokefrontiers.com**
